title: Hyphae Memory Category v1
description: 8-category memory taxonomy for hyphae. Defines stable category IDs, descriptions, and merge semantics. Producers use these IDs as topic prefixes; cap and cortina use them for structured rendering and tagging.

description.description: What memories in this category represent.

merge_semantics.description: How updates in this category are merged. replace = full replacement, append = add to existing content, accumulate = always add new entry.

example_topics.description: Representative hyphae topic strings that map to this category.
